text.p: Merrill Lynch said it had upgraded Brazilian private steelmaker Acesita to accumulate from neutral.
-- also said it had raised its 1997 net income projection to 34.6 million reais or 0.20 per share from 15.3 million reais or 0.09 per share.
-- Merrill Lynch analyst Francisco Martins said in a report the upgrade was based on the following reasons:
* the company's expansion program is near completion and should no longer interrupt current production, providing operational earnings momentum.
* the new stainless line is coming on-line in April 1998, and should also add to earning momentum.
* domestic demand for stainless is rebounding, which should increase profitability.
-- also said the second quarter's bottom line of 11.2 million reais was substantially above the brokerage's projection of 5.2 million reais.
-- Acesita preferred was up 2.02 percent at 2.52 reais earlier on the Sao Paulo bolsa.
